sources.snippet: When is a building permit needed? A building permit is needed for the following types of projects: New House New Commercial or Industrial Building New Additions Finishing Basements Remodels where Interior Walls or Structures are Significantly Modified New Egress Windows or New Differently-Sized Windows (where walls are modified) New Fencing New Shingling/Roofing New Siding Detached or Attached Garages Accessory Structures such as Garden Sheds
